metadata.title: Mid-Century Crooner Album Cover
useCases: Retro jazz or swing promotional posters

retrievalProfile.description: A nostalgic mid-century portrait layout featuring a central male figure with a soft outer glow against a textured, magenta-tinted floral background.
triggerTerms: retro portrait with soft white glow

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, warm-toned male portrait in a suit, isolated by a soft white outer glow from a grainy, magenta-saturated background of tall grass or flowers, topped with clean white sans-serif and serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered and slightly cropped at the waist
Magenta background providing high color contrast to warm skin tones
Soft white halo separating the subject from the busy background texture
Top-aligned primary text with secondary italicized text immediately below
coreInvariants: Soft white outer glow on the subject
Grainy, film-like texture across the entire image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up portrait, centered horizontally, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, highlighted by the white glow and central placement.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large top text, moves down to the face, then to the secondary text and bottom badge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Limited; the background is densely textured with magenta foliage.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background magenta; high value in the white text and glow.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Clean geometric sans-serif and transitional serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary text is all-caps with uniform stroke weight
Secondary text is title-case italics with moderate contrast
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Geometric sans-serif for impact paired with a traditional italic serif for elegance.
graphicDevices: Magenta pill-shaped badge at bottom left
Soft white outer glow around subject

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, mid-century geometric sans-serif look of the primary text.
Provides the classic, readable serif contrast for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a 1950s suit, centered, with a soft white outer glow. The background should be a dense texture of tall grass or flowers heavily tinted in magenta with a grainy, vintage film texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, all-caps white sans-serif text at the top. Below it, add a smaller line of white italicized serif text. Place a magenta oval badge in the bottom left corner with white script-like serif text inside.

verificationChecks: Does the subject have a soft white halo?
Is the top text all-caps and white?
Is there a magenta badge in the bottom left?

adjustableVariables: Width of the white outer glow
Font weight of the primary text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the magenta tint does not bleed into the subject's skin tones excessively.
Verify the white glow effectively separates the subject from the background.
Check that the text remains legible against the textured background.
Confirm the vintage grain is consistent across the entire composition.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a warm-toned central portrait + soft white halo + magenta-tinted textured background + top-heavy white sans-serif typography.
